description: Visual AI coding teams with live supervision, account routing, quotas, schedules and two-way messaging.
setting.profiles: Personal CLI/account profiles. Use SecretStorage for tokens. Empty model uses CLI default.
setting.autoSwitch: Before a step, use another same-provider profile if the selected profile has a fresh exhausted quota. Never retry a failed step automatically.
setting.quotaThreshold: Used-quota percentage threshold for stopping or switching accounts.
setting.maxChildTasks: Maximum repair tasks delegated by the audit.
setting.allowEdits: Allow implementation and repair steps to edit files with provider-native permission modes. Audit and final review stay in plan/read-only mode. Gemini needs its own tool permission configuration.
setting.timezone: IANA timezone for new schedules. Empty uses the system timezone; saved schedules retain theirs.
setting.resumeAfterQuota: Resume paused steps only when fresh quota data confirms capacity. Failed CLI steps are not retried.
setting.routingMode: Round robin opts into the explicit per-role pool, including its model/provider changes.
setting.rotationPools: Allowed profile IDs in turn order per role. Fresh available quota is required.
setting.resumeProviderLimited: Opt in to retry a provider-limited step after a new available quota snapshot. The previous attempt may have edited files. Requires resumeAfterQuota for automatic continuation.
setting.backupBeforeEdits: Before each editable Dev/Repair step, snapshot Git tracked + non-ignored files and explicit extra paths into local VS Code storage.
setting.backupMaxMB: Maximum source snapshot size in MB.
setting.backupStorageMB: Source snapshots are kept. At this cap editable work is blocked until you manage backups or raise the cap.
setting.backupExtraPaths: Additional relative files/directories inside the task workspace, for ignored runtime data. Snapshots of active databases are file copies, not transaction-consistent database backups.
setting.quotaRefreshSeconds: Quota-source refresh interval while VS Code is open. The scheduler checks this interval every 15 seconds.
setting.language: Runtime language. Auto follows the VS Code display language; unsupported languages fall back to English. Command Palette titles follow the VS Code display language.
profile.quotaFile: Absolute path to normalized quota JSON written by your integration.
config.isolateTasks: Create each new task in a separate Git worktree from committed HEAD. Source must be clean. Checkouts are retained for review; changes are never merged automatically.
config.openTasksInCodex: Prepare one Codex desktop chat at each new task folder when execution starts. Requires the desktop app; does not submit a prompt or synchronize the CLI task.

command.clearWorkflow: RelayCrew: Remove Workflow Guide for New Tasks
profile.modelPolicy: Automatic flagship uses the current CLI catalog/provider alias; cli follows existing CLI settings; custom uses an optional model ID.
profile.quotaCeiling: Optional usage ceiling (1–100%). The lower account/global or daily-plan threshold stops subsequent steps; it does not interrupt an in-flight request.
profile.hosting: Cloud by default. Local HTTP endpoints must use loopback; check the server model configuration for actual inference location.
profile.transport: CLI is the default. Compatible HTTP profiles provide read-only chat/review with explicit context.
profile.endpoint: OpenAI-compatible API base URL including /v1. HTTPS for cloud, loopback for local. API keys belong in SecretStorage.
setting.completionNotifications: Completion notifications: each step and entire flow, entire flow only, or history without completion popups.
profile.preferred: Prefer this account when creating a provider-based team preset. Existing task assignments stay unchanged.
command.liveSession: RelayCrew: Open Live Session in Separate Tab
profile.accountEmail: Declared account email. This label does not authenticate or switch the provider login.
profile.fallbackEligible: Consider this profile for automatic fallback. A separate login binding and fresh available quota are required.
setting.maxReviewRounds: Maximum implementation/audit rounds for new tasks (1–10, default 3). Repairs are independently rechecked; unresolved findings stop at the limit. Each round may contain several bounded repair tasks. Internal provider tool calls are not counted as workbench rounds.
